papers.title: The Influence of Processing Parameters on Selective Laser Melting of A357 Al Cast Alloy
papers.venue: 26th Advanced Aerospace Materials and Processes (AeroMat) Conference and Exposition (May 11–14, 2015)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究航空铝A357的SLM工艺参数，与生物医学植入物设计和力学性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化A357铝合金SLM工艺参数以提高致密度
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数进行SLM实验
summary_zh.result: 确定了最佳工艺窗口，获得高致密度试样
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和显微组织观察验证

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters for A357 aluminum cast alloy to achieve full density.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of laser power, scan speed, and other parameters in SLM experiments.
summary_en.result: Identified optimal parameter window yielding near-fully dense specimens.
summary_en.validation: Validation via density measurement and microstructural observation.

papers.title: On Influence of Processing Parameters on Surface Roughness and Microstructure of Hastelloy X Produced by Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.venue: 26th Advanced Aerospace Materials and Processes (AeroMat) Conference and Exposition (May 11–14, 2015)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究航空用镍基高温合金Hastelloy X的SLM工艺参数对表面粗糙度和微观结构的影响，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address porous implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; focuses on aerospace alloy processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对Hastelloy X表面粗糙度和微观结构的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数，测量表面粗糙度并分析微观结构
summary_zh.result: 工艺参数显著影响表面粗糙度和微观组织形态
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量和微观结构观察

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting (SLM) processing parameters on surface roughness and microstructure of Hastelloy X.
summary_en.method: Experimental variation of SLM parameters including laser power and scan speed, followed by surface roughness measurement and microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: Processing parameters significantly affect surface roughness and microstructural features.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of surface roughness and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Manufacturing of porous-structured Ti6Al4V alloy by selective laser melting: surface roughness, mechanical properties and corrosion resistance
papers.venue: International Thermal Spray Conference and Exposition (ITSC)

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制备多孔Ti6Al4V合金，并报告了表面粗糙度和力学性能，但缺乏疲劳测试和骨整合评估。
llm.why_not_core: Does not cover fatigue behavior, osseointegration, or in vivo testing; limited to static mechanical properties and corrosion.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备多孔Ti6Al4V合金并研究其表面粗糙度、力学性能和耐腐蚀性。
summary_zh.method: 使用选择性激光熔化制造多孔Ti6Al4V样品，并表征其表面粗糙度、力学性能和腐蚀行为。
summary_zh.result: 报告了工艺参数与性能之间的相互关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和腐蚀试验验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the surface roughness, mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance of porous Ti6Al4V fabricated by selective laser melting for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Porous Ti6Al4V samples were manufactured using selective laser melting and characterized for surface roughness, mechanical properties, and corrosion behavior.
summary_en.result: The study reports the interrelationships between processing parameters and the resulting properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and corrosion tests were performed to validate the performance.
